author: Veli Raiya
title: Fantasy book map designer and character illustrator
content: Looking for a fantasy book map designer + character illustrator! Definitely does not have to be the same artist for both. Bonus points if you are a fantasy author recommending someone you have personally worked with. For character art, prefers realistic, epic fantasy concept art over cartoon illustration; book is lighter fantasy but wants grounded, lifelike art. Open to different styles. Bonus points if the artist can do POC and a wide variety of ethnicities. Portraits for the time being, with more work if the style fits the series. For the map, wants something detailed and immersive with a classic fantasy-map feel, open stylistically. Contact: reply on the Threads post or share work/recs; author is active in replies. https://www.threads.com/@veliraiyawrites/post/Ddz7KZNCetH
